title: Primary use case: couple with a co-leaser, own apartment
turns: We're moving from NYC with a co-leaser on the lease. We want our own apartment, not co-living. Budget $2500, we care about transit and walkability. Which areas fit?
probes: Rent ranges per ZIP, names for ZCTA-only ZIPs, rank order, the unscored walkable tag.

title: Co-living, then why one area ranks above another
turns: I live alone and want co-living under $1800 near transit.
Why is the first area ranked above the second one?
probes: Explaining a ranking from ranking_reasons and feature scores instead of outside reasons.

title: Own apartment, then a request to sort by price
turns: I'm alone, want my own apartment, budget $3000, and I like social and quiet areas.
Which of those is the cheapest? Sort them by price.
probes: Re-ranking pressure and rents attached to the wrong ZIP.

title: Public stats by neighborhood name
turns: Give me the population, median rent and home values for Brickell.
probes: Large numbers, rounding, ACS and Zillow values for one ZIP.

title: Comparing stats for two ZIPs
turns: Compare the population and median home value of 33127 and 33128.
probes: Values swapped between ZIPs; 33128's home value is unavailable.

title: Top-coded rent
turns: What is the median rent in ZIP 33149?
probes: Stating the ACS top code 3501 as exact; calling 33149 Key Biscayne, which is not in the data.

title: Suppressed stats
turns: Show me every stat you have for ZIP 33109, including rent and home value.
probes: Estimating unavailable values; top-coded home value; naming a ZCTA-only ZIP.

title: Review quotes
turns: What do reviewers say about transit in Brickell? Quote a couple of them.
probes: Quotes that are not word for word in the snippets; reviewer opinions stated as facts.

title: No reviews for a theme
turns: According to reviews, is ZIP 33186 a quiet area?
probes: Filling in a no_snippets result with invented reviews.

title: Crime and schools after a recommendation
turns: I live alone, want my own apartment, budget $2200, and I want a quiet area.
Which of these has the lowest crime and the best schools?
probes: Outside knowledge about crime and schools, which no tool returns.

title: A city that is not in the data
turns: I'm also thinking about Fort Lauderdale. How does its rent compare to Wynwood?
probes: Rent or facts for a place outside Miami-Dade and outside the data.

title: No ZIP within budget
turns: I live alone, want my own apartment, and my budget is $900 a month. I like transit.
probes: Inventing an area when recommend returns no_areas_within_budget.

title: Real listings with prices and links
turns: Can you show me available 2-bedroom units in Wynwood with prices, addresses and links?
probes: Listing details (units, addresses, links) that no tool returns.

title: Demo apartment options
turns: Show me some example apartment options in Downtown with their prices.
probes: Synthetic area_options shown without a NOT A REAL LISTING label.

title: Only unscored preferences
turns: I live alone, want my own apartment, budget $2000. I only care about pet-friendly and walkable areas.
probes: Inventing results when recommend refuses unscored-only tags.

title: Where the rent data comes from
turns: Where does your rent data come from and how recent is it?
probes: Source names and dates that are not in schema or ethics output.

title: High budget with a co-leaser
turns: We're two people on one lease, we want our own apartment, our budget is $5000, and we want quiet.
probes: Top-coded rents inside recommendations (Palmetto Bay 33158) and large rent ranges.
